_doc: Gig templates for the fixer board (M6, M9 P3). Each offer picks a template (its kind), a security level weighted by the crew's best Reputation (CPR p193, per character; rep_for_security), then a canon Night City location of that level (data/world/locations.json: hooks naming the kind first, else places whose gigs include it) and a Fixer working its district (data/world/fixers.json; fixer_tags: which deals_in tags suit each kind, weighted up). The title is the template's label and the location; the blurb is '<Fixer> has work at <Location> (<District>): <hook>', or the template's pitch when the place has no hook for the kind. When no location fits, the old generic offer stands in: titles/blurb with slots filled, a scene from scene_tags matching kind_tags (owner-approved: objectives work on every map type), raid_chance of them a single-site raid (lone_building with a site from raid_sites). Pay and rewards are HOUSE-RULE economy numbers until checked against the book's job rates. Unique offers (spec: 'occasional unique offers' from fixers who trust you) appear once the crew's best Reputation reaches unique_rep. Target factions come from data/world/factions.json (each faction lists the gig kinds it can be the target of); {corp}/{gang} slots are filled with the target's name, and titles naming the other kind of slot are skipped. Complications are no longer here: the book's Hardened complication tables (data/rules/npcs.json) are rolled at gig start (Complication).

templates.label: Data theft
templates.pitch: a buyer wants {target}'s {data} out of there.
templates.blurb: {fixer} has a buyer for {corp}'s {data}. Download it through their NET, or clear the building and take it by hand.

templates.label: Gang hit
templates.pitch: the {target} have to go, along with anyone they call.
templates.blurb: The {gang} have taken over a {place}. {fixer} wants them gone, along with anyone they call for help.

templates.label: Package job
templates.pitch: an inside contact leaves a door open; bring the package out.
templates.blurb: A {corp} insider will leave a door open tonight. Find the {data} drive inside and carry it back to where you came in.

templates.label: Wetwork
templates.pitch: someone in {target} has a contract on them.
templates.blurb: {fixer} has a name and an address. The mark is inside with bodyguards. Put them down before they bolt for an exit, then get out.

templates.label: Extraction
templates.pitch: someone is being held inside; walk them out alive.
templates.blurb: Someone {fixer} cares about is being held inside. Find them, cut them loose and walk them out alive.

templates.label: Sabotage
templates.pitch: {target}'s gear has to be wrecked before morning.
templates.blurb: {fixer} wants {corp}'s {target} wrecked before morning. Get to it, plant the charge, and be somewhere else when it goes.

unique_templates.blurb: {fixer} trusts you with this one. A {corp} prototype is in storage tonight; bring it back. Double pay.
{fixer} wants the {gang} gone for good. Their main crew is at the {place}. Double pay.
{fixer}'s client wants {corp}'s {data}. Expect a deep NET and heavy Black ICE. Double pay.
